methodology.order: Rotate library order each round; repeat this suite in fresh processes
methodology.topology: MessageChannel, two endpoints in one event loop; worker startup/scheduling excluded
methodology.payload: Distinct preallocated objects per member; every returned scalar/full text and exact remote echo invocation count verified; burst completion RTT sampled separately
methodology.guarantees: CrossBus retains default payload/request limits, peer binding and timeout. Comlink has no per-call timeout; birpc defaults to 60s; Penpal default has none, plus a cached 30s-timeout variant. API semantics differ.
